title: Training Mixed-Monotone Neural Networks for Verification Without Set Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most formal verification approaches for neural networks conservatively enclose the output set of the neural network. However, computing a tight output enclosure is in general computationally hard. We sidestep this challenge with a novel neural network architecture that realizes mixed-monotone functions as the difference of monotone subnetworks. By utilizing the theory on mixed-monotone systems, this reduces the computation of a tight output enclosure from complicated set propagation to two simple forward passes of opposite corners of an input interval. Moreover, because the size of the resulting enclosure is a closed-form function of the weights of the neural network, we can directly minimize it during training. We prove a lower bound on the size of any such enclosure, given by the total variation of the represented function generalized to several inputs, which makes it possible to compare the tightness of the enclosure against the optim

translated_title: 训练混合单调神经网络以实现无需集合传播的验证
translated_abstract: 大多数针对神经网络的形式化验证方法都会保守地包络神经网络的输出集合。然而，计算一个紧凑的输出包络在通常情况下是计算困难的。我们通过一种新颖的神经网络架构绕过了这一挑战，该架构将混合单调函数实现为两个单调子网络之差。借助混合单调系统的理论，这将紧凑输出包络的计算从复杂的集合传播简化为对输入区间两个相反角点的两次简单前向传播。此外，由于所得包络的大小是神经网络权重的闭式函数，我们可以在训练过程中直接将其最小化。我们证明了任何此类包络大小的一个下界，该下界由推广到多输入情形的所表示函数的全变差给出，这使得将包络的紧凑性与最优情况进行比较成为可能。
tldr: 提出一种将混合单调函数实现为两个单调子网络之差的新型神经网络架构，把紧凑输出包络的计算从复杂的集合传播简化为两次简单前向传播，且因包络大小是权重的闭式函数，可在训练中直接最小化它。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel neural network architecture realizing mixed-monotone functions as the difference of two monotone subnetworks, reducing tight output enclosure computation from complex set propagation to two simple forward passes, and enabling direct minimization of the enclosure size during training since it is a closed-form function of the network weights.
